review_comment: The idea behind this is to center the seekbar. After your changes, the seekbar will not be centered. Maybe it is better to detect which of both fields is wider and enlarge the other one.

There is one thing to note: theoretically currentTime width is never bigger than endTime's, so the first 'if' in the code above could be removed.

I think it would be possible to do something using [a table layout](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/6647177/set-equal-width-of-columns-in-table-layout-in-android), but I'm not sure.
